photos.alt: Marie-Thérèse stands in a long black dress and pearls before a pale sofa, one hand raised to her head, half lost in shadow under a ceiling lamp.
Marie-Thérèse stands in front of the sofa in her black dress, one arm bent behind her head, two ceiling lamps glowing above her.
Marie-Thérèse leans with both hands on a kitchen counter, looking straight at the camera, strands of pearls over a black halter dress.
Marie-Thérèse leans on the counter seen through glass, a faint reflection of the tap laid over her black dress and pearls.
Marie-Thérèse sits on the counter with her bare back to the camera, looking over her shoulder, her long dark ponytail falling down her spine.
Seen through glass, Marie-Thérèse sits bare-backed on the counter beside the sink, turning her head toward the camera.
Marie-Thérèse stands behind the counter in the dim room, pearls catching the light of a single lamp behind her.
Marie-Thérèse stands almost in silhouette behind the counter, hands spread on its edge, a bright wall and a lamp pole behind her.
Marie-Thérèse in near silhouette behind the counter, head tilted back, pearls showing against the black dress.
Marie-Thérèse stands small and centred in the room behind the counter, the lamp pole cutting the frame to her right.
Marie-Thérèse stands beside the lamp pole with one hand on her hip, the white door at the right edge of the frame.
A tall frame of Marie-Thérèse in profile, hand on her hip, the lamp pole running through the dark foreground.
Marie-Thérèse sits on the pale sofa under two lamps, framed between dark glass panels, looking at the camera.
Marie-Thérèse sits on the sofa with both arms stretched along its back, the black dress spread around her.
Marie-Thérèse leans back on the sofa, one arm along its back and one hand at her head, her legs out on the tiled floor.
Marie-Thérèse rests her head on her hand on the sofa, the lamp pole in the foreground and the room washed in light.
Marie-Thérèse sits forward on the sofa, arms spread on the cushions, looking straight at the camera past a dark edge of the frame.
Marie-Thérèse sits on the sofa with one hand on the seat, her dress open at the leg, a dark shape blurring the left of the frame.
Marie-Thérèse sits sideways on the sofa, one hand on its edge, looking down past her shoulder, pearls hanging over the black dress.
Seen from behind the counter, Marie-Thérèse sits on the sofa under two bright lamps, looking up into the light.
Marie-Thérèse leans over the counter by the tap in a wide view of the apartment, lamps hanging above her and a door open behind.
Close portrait of Marie-Thérèse looking straight into the lens, hair pulled back, long pearl earrings and strands of pearls at her neck.
Marie-Thérèse leans on both hands over the counter toward the camera, the tap blurred in the foreground and the room behind her.
The apartment seen through its glass front at night: Marie-Thérèse stands against the far wall under hanging lamps, arms reaching to the sides.
Through the glass, Marie-Thérèse leans against the wall with one arm stretched out, the kitchen counter and a pot in the foreground.
A wider view through the glass, Marie-Thérèse small against the far wall, the sofa to the left and the counter in front.
Through the glass, Marie-Thérèse presses against the far wall with her arm raised, the room dark around the lit kitchen.
Through the glass, Marie-Thérèse stands against the wall with her hands behind her head, the lamps glowing above.
Through the glass, Marie-Thérèse stands with her hands at her head against the wall, the edge of the window frame darkening the left.
Marie-Thérèse stands against the far wall with her hands clasped in front of her, alone between the sofa and the open door.
